import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

root = Path('/mnt/c/GitHub/deadsync')
folder = root / 'target/alsa-performance/reference-verification'
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-c', f'safe.directory={root}', 'show', '434ea4029:crates/deadlib-audio-backend-alsa/src/lib.rs'], cwd=root)
source = original.decode().replace('\r\n', '\n')
baseline = (root / 'target/alsa-performance/baseline/lib.rs').read_text().replace('\r\n', '\n')
assert baseline.replace('#[cfg(test)]\nmod perf_tests;\n\n', '', 1) == source
(folder / 'lib.rs').write_text(source.replace('#![cfg(target_os = "linux")]\n', '#![cfg(target_os = "linux")]\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod perf_tests;\n', 1))
shutil.copyfile(root / 'crates/deadlib-audio-backend-alsa/src/perf_tests.rs', folder / 'perf_tests.rs')
deps = Path('/home/perfecttaste/deadsync-alsa-target/release/deps')
command = ['rustc', '--test', '--edition=2024', '--crate-name', 'deadlib_audio_backend_alsa',
           '-C', 'opt-level=3', '-C', 'lto=fat', '-C', 'codegen-units=16',
           '-L', f'dependency={deps}']
for name in ['alsa', 'deadlib_audio_core', 'deadlib_platform', 'libc', 'log']:
    paths = list(deps.glob(f'lib{name}-*.rlib'))
    assert len(paths) == 1, (name, paths)
    command += ['--extern', f'{name}={paths[0]}']
command += [str(folder / 'lib.rs'), '-o', str(folder / 'alsa-tests')]
subprocess.run(command, check=True, cwd=root)
binary = str(folder / 'alsa-tests')
checks = []
result = subprocess.run([binary, '--test-threads=1'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
checks.append(dict(scenario='unit', output=result.stdout + result.stderr))
fixture_env = {**os.environ, 'LD_PRELOAD': str(root / 'target/alsa-performance/verified-final/fixture.so')}
for layout in ['regular', 'empty', 'unmatched_default', 'bad_name', 'probe_error']:
    result = subprocess.run([binary, 'fixture_enumeration', '--ignored', '--test-threads=1'],
                            env={**fixture_env, 'ALSA_FIXTURE_LAYOUT': layout}, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    checks.append(dict(scenario=layout, output=result.stdout + result.stderr))
for delay in ['-1', '0', '240', '4294967295']:
    for failed in [False, True]:
        env = {**fixture_env, 'ALSA_FIXTURE_DELAY': delay}
        if failed:
            env['ALSA_FIXTURE_STATUS_ERROR'] = '1'
        result = subprocess.run([binary, 'fixture_timing', '--ignored', '--test-threads=1'],
                                env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        checks.append(dict(scenario=f'delay={delay},error={failed}', output=result.stdout + result.stderr))
report = dict(reference_commit='434ea4029', original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),
              command=command, checks=checks)
(root / 'docs/performance/2026-10-26-alsa-reference-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
print('Original source: unit checks and 13 fixture scenarios passed.')
